heads.t: 49萬人研究：喝「1飲品」心血管風險降11% 每天6至8杯最佳 喝對飲品能養生！食安專家韋恩分享研究指出，規律喝茶的人，心血管疾病風險可降低11%，其中紅茶的效果比綠茶更穩定。不過，喝多少、茶怎麼泡也有學問。 14 分鐘前｜健康 49萬人研究：喝「1飲品」心血管風險降11% 每天6至8杯最佳 14 分鐘前｜健康
heads.en: Four hundred and forty thousand people study: the risk of drinking a "one drink" cardiac risk is 11 percent lower, the best six to eight cups a day. Food expert Wayne shared studies suggest that the risk of cardiovascular disease can be reduced by 11 per cent for those who drink tea, where the effect of red tea is more stable than green tea. However, there is a question of how much tea to drink. 14 minutes ago, a 490,000-person study: 11% reduction in cardiovascular risk from one drink, 6-8 cups per day, 14 minutes ago.

heads.t: 名醫爸病逝半年！林逸欣認了「本想停辦生日會」 台上憶亡父淚崩 「音樂精靈」林逸欣昨（7）日於Corner Max盛大舉辦 2026《林逸欣生日音樂會》，一口氣帶來25首歌曲並展現樂器絕活，現場擠得水泄不通。然而這場演唱會對她卻極具考驗與痛楚，她的父親林春銘醫師今年4月不幸病逝，讓她一度萌生停辦念頭，最終因想起「爸爸最愛看她玩音樂」才決定繼續唱下去。她自彈自唱寫給父親的〈你是我的天空〉數度哽咽落淚，底下粉絲也紛紛感動掉淚。 22 分鐘前｜娛樂 名醫爸病逝半年！林逸欣認了「本想停辦生日會」 台上憶亡父淚崩 22 分鐘前｜娛樂
heads.en: Six months after his death, Lin recognized that his father's tears were falling, and the music elves were squeezing at Corner Max's big concert in 2026, which brought in 25 songs and showed no instrumentation. However, the concert was extremely difficult and painful for her, whose father, Dr. Lin Chun-hyun, died in April of this year, and finally decided to continue singing because she thought "Daddy loves to watch her music". She sings herself to her father, "You are my sky" , and her fans cry. 22 minutes ago, a doctor died six months ago.
